name: markvspec
description: Markdown-first screen specification format with live preview tooling.

scripts.check:generated-docs: npm run check:grammar-docs && npm run check:reference-docs
scripts.check:docs-site: npm run build:pages && npm run check:pages-site
scripts.audit:docs-code: npm run build -w @markvspec/core && npm run build -w @markvspec/document-renderer && npm run build -w @markvspec/exporter && node scripts/audit-docs-code.mjs
scripts.audit:examples: npm run build -w packages/vscode-extension && rm -rf packages/vscode-extension/dist-test && tsc -p packages/vscode-extension/tsconfig.test.json && node --loader ./packages/vscode-extension/test-vscode-loader.mjs --test packages/vscode-extension/dist-test/test/example-audit.test.js
scripts.check:release: npm run check:generated-docs && npm test && npm run check:core-browser && npm run audit:examples && npm run audit:docs-code && npm run audit:docs-reference-vocabulary && npm run check:docs-links && npm run check:docs-site && npm run check:print-regression && npm run check:readme-release
scripts.test: npm run test -w @markvspec/core && npm run test -w @markvspec/document-renderer && npm run test -w @markvspec/exporter && npm run test -w @markvspec/cli && npm run test -w packages/vscode-extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @markvspec/core && npm run build -w @markvspec/core && npm run typecheck -w @markvspec/document-renderer && npm run build -w @markvspec/document-renderer && npm run typecheck -w @markvspec/exporter && npm run build -w @markvspec/exporter && npm run typecheck -w @markvspec/cli && npm run build -w @markvspec/cli && npm run typecheck -w packages/vscode-extension
